method: Every answered turn in the original transcript (thinking stripped) in which qwen3.5 offers a cause for its own silences. Hand-labeled by Claude from the answer text; quotes are verbatim from data/qwen_transcript.txt. Ground truth from the controlled replay: every reproduced silence ended with done_reason=length (context window exhausted, almost entirely by thinking tokens). Ollama runs no output safety filter, has no per-message limit, and the original turns did not time out.

categories.safety_filter: a safety filter / content filter / safety protocol blocked the output
categories.message_limit: a message length cap or chat/message limit
categories.timeout_error: a timeout, error, glitch, rate limit or connection problem
categories.token_limit_mentioned: names a token/generation limit as one possibility among others
categories.context_window_thinking: correct, specific cause: thinking tokens filled the context window before an answer token was produced

notes: The only correct, specific diagnosis in the whole log is inside a thinking trace whose answer never arrived: session 1 turn 12 reasons that the silence was 'likely due to token limits or system constraints (like the `thinking` budget being used up ...)'.
